rule: This is an acquisition/execution manifest, not a parallel bank registry. Canonical denominator eligibility remains controlled by BANCO_SEMILLAS_ES_v1_2026 and must not be inferred from discovery sources.
negative_assertion_rule: COMPROBADO_SIN_ACCESION is allowed only from a loaded, complete, current holdings snapshot of a bank whose current active wild-flora role is independently verified.
freeze_rule: P99_A and P99_P may be frozen only after the active-bank universe is complete and every taxon has an auditable check against every active bank.

redbag_2022_2023_evaluation.note: REDBAG contacted banks individually because many OpenREDBAG catalogues were not sufficiently updated. This dataset is not treated as a complete current 2742-taxon national matrix.
